svg.title: Locus: show your coding agent only the code it needs
svg.desc: Animated replay of a real held-out benchmark run. Task: "vanilla subscriber not notified after nested store.set and sub/unsub inside a write" on pmndrs/jotai at d8ed488. Each of the 130 cells is a source file. Locus anchors 6 files, adds their dependency closure, and excludes the rest: 17 of 130 files, 17.7K of 62.4K estimated tokens, 72% less context. The file the maintainer fixed, src/vanilla/internals.ts, is in the Slice.
svg.text: Held-out run · one cell per source file
